entities.summary: Peter Tiepold is a former light-middleweight boxer from East Germany. He was a quarterfinalist at the 1968 Olympic Games and a bronze medallist at the 1972 Olympic Games. He competed for the SC Dynamo Berlin / Sportvereinigung (SV) Dynamo.
